name: hcs-ipfs-document-vault
description: HCS-anchored IPFS document vault: upload to IPFS, attest CID+sha256 on Hedera Consensus Service, optional HIP-336 pin fee, Mirror Node verify.

envVars.description: Operator account ID (e.g. 0.0.x) for HCS submit / topic create
Operator private key (ECDSA or ED25519). Never commit.
HCS topic ID that stores vault attestation messages
IPFS backend: kubo (default local HTTP API) or pinata
Kubo HTTP API base URL when IPFS_PROVIDER=kubo (default http://127.0.0.1:5001)
Public IPFS gateway prefix for fetch links
Pinata JWT when IPFS_PROVIDER=pinata. Never commit.
Optional Pinata API key (legacy; prefer PINATA_JWT)
Optional Pinata API secret (legacy; prefer PINATA_JWT)
Optional HTS token for pin fee; leave empty for free attest
Optional pin fee in token base units (bigint string)
Optional treasury account that receives the pin fee
Public network label for HashScan links
Public topic id for the verify UI
Public IPFS gateway URL shown in the UI

steps.text: HCS-anchored IPFS document vault: bytes on IPFS, proof on Hedera Consensus Service. Without IPFS there is nowhere for bytes; without HCS there is no public tamper-evident proof.

steps.label: Set HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID and HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY in .env
steps.text: Use the faucet account. Never commit .env.

steps.label: Start local Kubo (IPFS) or point IPFS_API_URL at a reachable HTTP API
steps.text: Demo happy path: ipfs daemon (API on :5001). Dry-run: pass a precomputed CID to the attest API.

steps.label: Create an HCS topic (optional if HCS_TOPIC_ID already set)
Verify a CID against the HCS topic (Mirror Node)

steps.text: See README.md and RUNBOOK.md for upload → attest → verify, optional HIP-336 pin fee, and the status table.
